name: Titan Grip (Combat)
body:
You are adept as using weapons of great proportions to take down large foes.

Prerequisite: Power Attack, Titan Technique, Str 17, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: The penalty for wielding an inappropriately-sized weapon that is too large for you is reduced by 1. The penalty is reduced by an additional 1 at base attack bonus +8 and every 4 thereafter, to a maximum reduction of 5.
